app.q: Do my guests need to download an app?
app.a: No. Guests scan the QR code with their phone camera and upload from the browser. No app, no account and no password.

how.q: How do guests get the link?
how.a: Share the QR code or link in your invitation, a message or an email. With Premium you also get print-ready table cards and posters.

payment.a: Creating your event and getting your QR code is free. When you're ready for guests to start uploading, you choose Standard or Premium and pay once. No subscription, nothing renews.

quality.a: Never. We keep the exact file each guest's phone uploads, in its original resolution, and your ZIP contains those originals.

duration.q: How long are my photos kept?
duration.a: Your album stays open until 7 days after the event. Download the full-quality ZIP in that time; we'll remind you by email before anything is deleted. After that, all photos are permanently deleted, which keeps your guests' memories private.

privacy.a: Only you. Each guest only sees the photos they uploaded from their own phone. Nothing is public or listed on search engines, and everything is stored in the EU.

limits.q: What happens when the album is full?
limits.a: Guests see a friendly message and you can upgrade from Standard to Premium in one click. Nothing already uploaded is lost.

guests.q: Is there a limit on guests?
guests.a: No. Any number of guests can upload. Your plan only limits the total number of photos in the album: 1,500 with Standard, 5,000 with Premium.

misuse.q: What if my QR code ends up in the wrong hands?
misuse.a: Add a PIN that only your guests know (print it on the table card), limit uploads to the hours of your event, and cap how many photos each phone can add. Combined with our bot protection, a leaked QR code is useless to strangers.
